title: Less is More: Recursive Reasoning with Tiny Networks
blurb: A two-layer network applied recursively to a latent scratchpad and an answer, trained with deep supervision, beats much larger models on Sudoku, mazes and ARC-AGI puzzles.
intro: TRM simplifies the earlier Hierarchical Reasoning Model to one tiny network and three nested loops: latent recursion (update the scratchpad $z$ several times, then the answer $y$), deep recursion (repeat that, backpropagating only through the last pass), and deep supervision (repeat the whole thing with a loss each time and a learned halting signal). The steps review the small pieces it reuses; the capstone runs the full supervision loop.
